Every brand has a story. Kartall Graphic exists to make sure that story hits — visually, instantly, and unforgettably. We work at the intersection of bold concept and technical precision, turning ideas into identities that command attention.

From logo design and visual identity systems to packaging engineered for print, every project is treated as a unique creative challenge. We don't do generic. We don't do average. We build brands that stand out on a shelf, on a screen, and in memory.

Our process is rooted in strategy before aesthetics — understanding what a brand needs to say before deciding how it looks. The result is design that doesn't just look good, but works hard: communicating trust, quality, and character in a single glance.

"We don't make logos. We build visual languages — systems that carry a brand's entire promise in a single glance."

Brand Identity · Packaging
QAHWA — THE ART OF COFFEE

A premium coffee shop brand built around the ritual of Arabic coffee. The Qahwa monogram — an elegant interlocked Q and B — is applied across matte black packaging, kraft pouches, ceramic cups, and gift boxes. Each touchpoint communicates the same message: this is coffee as a ceremony, not a commodity.

Luxury BrandingLogo DesignPackagingCoffee
3 packaging formats — one seamless brand experience.

A complete identity system for an educational consulting group specialising in university admissions. The G-mark integrates a graduation cap into a clean letter form — instantly communicating expertise and aspiration. Rolled out across signage, brochures, digital portals, and branded stationery.

A bold packaging design for a Moroccan orange export brand. Deep black corrugated cardboard with rich orange illustration creates instant premium shelf presence. The Sabrina wordmark flows with warmth and elegance — a brand that makes fruit feel like a gift.

Brand Identity · Packaging · FMCG
SAMAKA — FROM THE OCEAN TO THE TABLE

A complete seafood brand system — from logo to product packaging. The whale tail mark communicates premium, artisanal quality. Applied across tin can labels, retail boxes, and lifestyle photography, the clean blue palette positions Samaka as a trusted, sustainable seafood brand.

Seafood BrandingLogo DesignPackagingFMCG

06
Brand Identity · Packaging · Rebranding
SULTAN TEA — A DYNASTY REBORN

Sultan Tea (est. 1936) needed a modern identity without losing heritage. The ornate red emblem was stripped to its essence: a geometric crown in forest green and gold. The identity then expanded across packaging pouches, retail cartons, and lifestyle art direction — creating a brand system built to last another 80 years.

Logo RebrandHeritage BrandPackagingArt Direction
80+ years of heritage — one iconic new identity.

AGAMOR — GOLD IN EVERY LETTER

A luxury footwear brand built on geometry and gold. The A·V·A monogram is a single architectural symbol — bold and immediately recognisable. Gold foil on deep forest packaging transforms every shoebox into a premium unboxing experience. A brand that speaks refinement without saying a word.
